snippet.title: Blinky's Adventure - Blumen Stroll SAGE 2025 Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
It's been a long time coming, but it's finally here!
Blinky's at SAGE 2025, with a whole new demo to feed ya faces!

This demo includes..
- 3 full super cool levels!
- A flethora of friends.. and foes!
- And.. a Sage's blessing?
- Also other things! You'll have to play the demo to see!

Coming soon to a SAGE 2025 Expo near you! Be there or be freaking square!!!!!!

To be notified of when exactly the expo goes live, why not join the blinky discord? It's free and full of vitamins! https://discord.gg/cwqyvQkrsU 

Never thought this moment would happen.. but see y'all at Sage! I'll be there!
